The supported assessment is OPEN for the remainder outside National Forests, pending PLO 399 at 12 FR 5780-5781 and PLO 614 at 14 FR 6517. Formal status is confirmed partially revoked in 1914; complete revocation remains unverified. If first_end means the earliest partial ending, 1947 is also incorrect: EO 1883 supplies the 1914 ending.

The cited BLM index, page 16, reference 140, confirms the date, serial, acreage description and all three cross-references.

The cited BLM index, page 115, reference 970B, confirms PLO 614, October 26, 1949, amendment of PLO 399 and 14 FR 6517. The supplied quotation slightly shortens the parenthetical: the source says 'Hot Springs or Medicinal Springs.'
